{{Quote|You bring credits?|Kitpth|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Kitpth''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold various items, such as [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. Other items Kitpth had for sale included a vaccine against the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] [[VX-736 injector]], a vaccine against [[Womp Rat fever]], and a piece of machinery referred to as a "reconfigured disassembler core".<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kitpth first appears in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
